title: Scheme and geometric Frobenius of the purity datum
statement:
In the purity conventions of this chapter ([def-pur-conventions]), fix the
global finite-field datum
$(p,a,q,k_0,k)$, and let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a
finite-type separated
morphism of $k_0$-schemes whose base change to $k$ is smooth of relative
dimension $d$. Put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, and
let $f:X\to Y$ be the base change of $f_0$. With
$\gamma=\operatorname{Frob}_q=\sigma^{-1}$ in the
geometric Frobenius convention of
the framework chapter, write

$$
g_{X,\gamma}=\operatorname{id}_{X_0}\times\Spec(\gamma),\
g_{Y,\gamma}=\operatorname{id}_{Y_0}\times\Spec(\gamma),
$$

for the semilinear (geometric-Galois) automorphisms, and let $\Phi_X$,
$\Phi_Y$ be the base changes to $X$ and $Y$ of the absolute $q$-power
Frobenius maps $F_{X_0}^{(q)}:X_0\to X_0$ and
$F_{Y_0}^{(q)}:Y_0\to Y_0$ [def-weil-absolute-frobenius-scheme],
formed using [def-pc-base-change]; they form the following commutative
squares:

$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
X & \xrightarrow{\ g_{X,\gamma}\ } & X\\
f\downarrow & & \downarrow f\\
Y & \xrightarrow{\ g_{Y,\gamma}\ } & Y,
\end{array}
\qquad
\begin{array}{ccc}
X & \xrightarrow{\ \Phi_X\ } & X\\
f\downarrow & & \downarrow f\\
Y & \xrightarrow{\ \Phi_Y\ } & Y;
\end{array}
$$

the first square is Cartesian, since its horizontal arrows are the
compatible semilinear automorphisms. The second is commutative by the
affine description of the absolute Frobenius in [def-weil-absolute-frobenius-scheme]; it
is not asserted to be Cartesian, and the scheme-Frobenius forms are
transported from the first square using the comparison isomorphisms, not
by applying Cartesian base change to the second square. The comparison
isomorphisms $\kappa_X,\kappa_Y$ are defined explicitly below (this
construction applies to the displayed schemes without assuming that their
structure morphisms are finite type): the absolute Frobenius
factorizes as

$$
\operatorname{Fr}^{(q)}_{Y/k}=g_{Y,\sigma}\Phi_Y=\Phi_Yg_{Y,\sigma}
$$

(the affine factorization is verified in the proof below, with
$\sigma:z\mapsto z^q$ the arithmetic Frobenius), so the scheme Frobenius and the geometric-Galois
automorphism $g_{Y,\gamma}=g_{Y,\sigma}^{-1}$ differ by the universal
homeomorphism $\operatorname{Fr}^{(q)}_{Y/k}$, under which the etale site
is invariant by [thm-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-invariance].
The isomorphisms are compatible with the pullback-composition
identifications and with $f$:

$$
Lf^*\kappa_Y=\kappa_XLf^*.
$$

Here $\operatorname{Fr}^{(q)}_{T/k}$ in the displayed factorization denotes the absolute morphism $F_T^{(q)}$, not the relative $k$-linear Frobenius [def-weil-absolute-frobenius-scheme]. All comparisons in this finite-coefficient datum are on $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, where $A=A_{E,n}$ is fixed by [def-pur-conventions]. For $T=X,Y$ the comparison is explicitly
$$
 \kappa_T:L\Phi_T^*\cong L(F_T^{(q)})^*Lg_{T,\gamma}^*
 \xrightarrow{\tau_T^{(a)}Lg_{T,\gamma}^*}Lg_{T,\gamma}^*,
$$
where $\tau_T^{(a)}$ is the canonical trivialization of [lem-pur-frobenius-trivialization-pullback]. The construction uses the canonical relative-Frobenius trivialization specified in [lem-pur-frobenius-trivialization-pullback]; it is defined for the displayed $k_0$-schemes even when only $f_0$, rather than their structure morphisms, is assumed finite type. The maps $\Phi_T$ are defined by base-changing $F_{T_0}^{(q)}$ [def-pc-base-change], which requires no absolute finite-type assumption.

For clarity, if $c_\Phi:Lf^*L\Phi_Y^*\cong L\Phi_X^*Lf^*$ and $c_g:Lf^*Lg_{Y,\gamma}^*\cong Lg_{X,\gamma}^*Lf^*$ denote the identifications from the two commuting squares, the last formula means the equality of natural transformations
$$
 c_g\circ(Lf^*\kappa_Y)=(\kappa_XLf^*)\circ c_\Phi.
$$
The first square is the square of [lem-weil-frobenius-square-cartesian]. The universal-homeomorphism assertion is [lem-pur-absolute-frobenius-universal-homeomorphism]; its etale-site consequence and the canonical pro-etale Frobenius trivialization are separate inputs.

proof.text: Define $g_{T,\gamma}=\operatorname{id}_{T_0}\times\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$. Apply [lem-weil-frobenius-square-cartesian] to $f_0$: it gives their inverses, $fg_{X,\gamma}=g_{Y,\gamma}f$, and the first Cartesian square without an absolute finite-type hypothesis.

proof.text: The existing Lean proof checks model Frobenius and arithmetic coefficient Frobenius on the two pullback projections. Naturality of absolute Frobenius is checked on sections using map_pow. The coefficient projection uses card(k0)=p^a. Pullback uniqueness gives both arithmetic factorizations; cancel g_sigma with g_gamma to obtain Phi=F followed by g_gamma. Applying the base-change functor to model Frobenius naturality gives the second commuting square.

source.place: definition, order 2579; assembly after the 2026-10-21 re-split

proof.text: Regard $T=X,Y$ as $k_0$-schemes. By [lem-pur-absolute-frobenius-universal-homeomorphism], $F_T^{(q)}$ is a universal homeomorphism. [thm-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-invariance] gives its small etale-topos equivalence. This supplies the etale assertion separately from the pro-etale comparison.

source.place: definition, order 2579; assembly after the 2026-10-21 re-split

proof.text: Use [lem-pur-frobenius-trivialization-pullback] at $b=a$ with the fixed finite ring $A$ to obtain the canonical $\tau_T^{(a)}$. By [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] inverse image is exact and induces derived pullback termwise. Pullback composition [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition] for $\Phi_T=g_{T,\gamma}F_T^{(q)}$ gives $d_T:L\Phi_T^*\cong L(F_T^{(q)})^*Lg_{T,\gamma}^*$. Define $\kappa_T=(\tau_T^{(a)}Lg_{T,\gamma}^*)d_T$; both factors are isomorphisms. This fixes the relative-Frobenius-normalized comparison.

source.place: definition, order 2579; assembly after the 2026-10-21 re-split

proof.text: The ordinary compositor selected by the Frobenius-trivialization theorem agrees with the ordinary compositor in lem-trf-derived-pullback-coherence: apply the composite-pullback adjunction Hom equivalence, evaluate its unit on sections, and use the conjugate-section equation of the first compositor and unit-section equation of the second. The latter theorem identifies its exact derived descent with the published derived compositor. Thus every frobeniusDerivedComposition used in kappa and the square comparisons is precisely the canonical derived compositor, with the specified orientation.

source.place: Tag 0D6D; normalization comparison by the adjunction unit

proof.text: Apply lem-pur-factorized-pullback-square-pasting with u=f, r=absolute q-power Frobenius, s=g_gamma and t=Phi. Equality elimination transports its canonical equation through the already proved factorizations of Phi. The arbitrary-pullback identity of lem-pur-frobenius-trivialization-pullback at exponent a supplies the r-square trivialization equation. Evaluate the pasting equation at an arbitrary derived object, postcompose by tau_X, use naturality of tau_X on the g-square comparison, and substitute the r-square trivialization equation. This yields c_g after Lf*kappa_Y equals kappa_X Lf* after c_Phi, for the actual unchanged kappa definitions.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q93-56bac89d8 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Re-split conforms to the 2026-10-21 note. The item statement is unchanged from base/live, and the item was not superseded. The proof shrinks from 3581 to 1951 characters (5 steps), and there are 2 statement-only unsplit nodes of comparable size (1465 and 1690 characters). Old step 2 (projection identities, pullback uniqueness, both factorizations, g_gamma cancellation) is now lem-pur-unrestricted-frobenius-factorization. The coherence subargument of old step 5 is now lem-pur-factorized-pullback-square-pasting, stated as one exact equation instead of 'any two composites agree'. Old steps 1, 3 and 4 and the tau-naturality part of step 5 stay in the assembly with the same citations. Nothing was dropped or blurred. Node A: I checked all six projection equations against Stacks 03SM/0CC7 (varieties.tex 7014/7032). F=g_sigma Phi=Phi g_sigma and Phi=g_gamma F follow, and Spec is contravariant so g_sigma g_gamma=id. Naturality holds. Small cases: empty T0, Spec k0 (Phi=id, F=Spec sigma), k0[e]/e^2, infinite type. It generalizes prop-trf-frobenius-factorization (which needs X0 finite type) without duplicating it, and the generalization is needed because only f0 is finite type. Node B: the functor types match. It is the standard pseudofunctor pasting law, following from lem-trf-derived-pullback-coherence associativity and the K-flat termwise description of Stacks 0D6D (sites-cohomology.tex 3658). Special cases r=s=id and u=id are fine. No Frobenius, tau or kappa appears, so it does not restate the item. Step 5: I recomputed (kappa_X Lf*)c_Phi = c_g(Lf* kappa_Y). This uses B with u=f, r=F^(q), s=g_gamma, t=Phi, where C_r equals c_{f,a} of lem-pur-frobenius-trivialization-pullback by that lemma's definition. It also uses naturality of tau_X at c_g. The hypotheses ur=ru (node A) and us=su (lem-weil-frobenius-square-cartesian) hold. Step 4: tau at b=a with F^a=F^(q), and d_T=c_{F,g}, match the statement's kappa. The closure grows by only the 2 new nodes: no new trf/batch-5 path, no cycle, no SGA. All cited ids exist (checked in side-live after the snapshot's chapter symlinks disappeared mid-review). The inherited split_report tool_use of lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition is accepted. No changes.

lean.note: The main declaration constructs the specified kappa composite from the normalized relative-Frobenius trivialization and exact descended composition comparison. The listed helpers expose both actual base-changed schemes and maps, both arithmetic factorizations, both square identifications and the full equality of natural transformations. No absolute finite-type hypothesis is imposed.
